title: Localized wiki mirror weakened a retained-scope claim
summary: The RU mirror of a reconciled wiki page rendered 'retained production binding' as 'current production configuration' and dropped the ObservationCrossing identifier while sibling mirrors preserved both, silently strengthening the claim and losing the canonical search term; strict OKF and the native-Russian audit pass on this drift.
remedy: Review changed locale mirrors against their English source for scope qualifiers and canonical identifiers before committing; structural validation does not establish semantic parity.

title: Release-artifact identity paragraph carried superseded hashes across two releases
summary: The Actors integration document's converged-handoff sentence bound Actors Weight ac206ec0 (0.7.24-era), Wasm f54ae4e3 and metadata 0116be51 while the v0.7.25 tree's own records bound Weight 9ce37ade, Wasm 25b9695f and metadata 75868ea7; the wrong triple survived into the 0.7.26 tree and was corrected only at the final public-truth pass.
remedy: Re-derive every artifact-identity sentence from the sealed candidate attestation or a fresh canonical build at each public-truth reconciliation; never carry hashes forward from the cycle in which they were written.

title: Workspace version bump reissues the production Wasm byte identity
summary: A controlled A/B changing only template/Cargo.toml and template/Cargo.lock proved the canonical production Wasm depends on the workspace package version: workspace 0.7.25 reproduces 77eaf529 bit-exactly, workspace 0.7.26 builds a distinct artifact (3388be55-family) with no intended semantic change. The development tree's Wasm-bound pins, heavy-profile evidence and attestation therefore cannot carry over to the release-version tree. Resolved by the release-preparation change: the version bump and bounded CHANGELOG section landed as `eeccbb2e`, the canonical rebuild reproduced `3388be55…`, every Wasm-bound pin and generated evidence was rebound as `7e0e1eb8`, and the mandatory `./scripts/validate-local.sh full` profile passed on that exact tree.
remedy: Land the release-version bump, the CHANGELOG section, the canonical rebuild, every downstream identity pin and any Wasm-derived generated evidence as one release-preparation change, then run the mandatory validation on that frozen tree.

title: Finite work backing mistaken for a new author payment flow
summary: Turning finite AwaitFunding transition-work backing into mandatory per-episode owner tickets before mapping existing fee and producer owners added a payment flow to the intended passive wait. The owner clarified that the Actor waits for its original unpaid service or 28-day apoptosis.
remedy: Separate internal work funding from authored payment semantics. Qualify dedicated bounded components inside existing fee or producer composition first. Absence from one quote does not prove missing backing: trace the complete fee-owner partition and recheck disjointness after any owner changes; propose a new payment surface only after an evidenced impossibility. Preserve the original unpaid boundary and grace through hints and tentative recovery.
related: Actors specification sections 8.7 and 10.7; reference integration Pipeline Fee and Lifetime-Cleanup Partition

title: Native inherent validation contaminated execution proof accounting
summary: Recording check_inherents and Executive execution as one native import call primed the old System BlockWeight key before initialization. The fixed signed retention block then differed from its author by 33 Normal ProofSize bytes and the fee multiplier, despite equal final raw proofs and identical economic effects.
remedy: Keep validation and wallet or verifier reads outside the execution recorder. Use fresh recording for the declared execution call; compare changed keys and per-call accounting before attributing an apparent native root mismatch to runtime semantics. Independent import remains a required gate.
